Measurement tolerances by category, editable in Settings > Tolerances. Lives on the persistent disk like the other editable configs, so this repo copy is only a SEED for a fresh install.

sizingCm  - how far a measurement may differ from the Golden Sample sizing chart.
printCm   - how far print/embroidery size and placement may differ from the approved artwork.
weightG   - finished product weight tolerance in grams. null where weight is not checked.

THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all three. For backwards compatibility the apparel sizingCm is ALSO written through to 'toleranceCm' in fits.json, because passFail.js, pdfBuilder.js, app.js and approval.js all read it from there to score apparel size rows. The write-through happens on save and is reconciled at startup, so the two cannot drift; never edit fits.toleranceCm by hand.

Only apparel size rows are scored automatically today. The other categories' sizingCm values are shown to the inspector as a reference until the Step 4 rework wires up per-category scoring.
